publication_copy.headline: TWELVE TEAMS. NINE POSTED RESULTS.
publication_copy.body: This is the official table through nine completed games. Dr. Duckhook entered alone at 6–3; seven teams followed at 5–4. Week 10’s scoring belongs on the live board until ESPN posts its outcomes. Equal records can occupy different seeds, so the order below follows the provider’s table.
